name: Claude Opus 5.5
traits: Generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5.
Puts the most important information up front.
Always thinks before it replies; thinking can no longer be switched off.

advice.value: work you supervise: feature work, debugging, and code review
give the model a way to check its work, such as a test to run

weakness: Trails GPT-6 Astra on agentic science research
resistance: Cyber and biology safeguards, falls back transparently

flavor.quote: it detected that the minute indexing in our own instructions was off by one and corrected for it

art_briefs: a colossal slate-grey owl with feathers of folded blueprint paper, calm and noble, perched on a cliff of stacked crates and carefully carrying them one by one across a gap to a new cliff, a brass magnifying lens hanging from one talon over an open ledger, a wooden chessboard balanced on its wing, a small parcel tied with string at its feet. Background: a floating archipelago of crates over still violet water. Slate, violet and saffron palette.

a giant knight carved from pale sandstone with moss-green enamel armour, serene and patient, kneeling to rebuild a long arched stone bridge brick by brick, a bundle of rolled spreadsheets tucked under one arm, a tiny arcade cabinet glowing at its knee, a loose thread of red yarn it is tracing back along the bridge to a hidden crack. Background: a bridge spanning two clouds over a dusk desert. Sandstone, moss green and coral palette.
